data.one_liner: A text field widget with real-time spell-checking and grammar correction using LanguageTool API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized Flutter TextField that integrates with the LanguageTool API to automatically detect and highlight spelling and grammar errors as users type. It includes controllers and popup UI for suggestions.
use_when: You need in-app spell-checking and grammar correction for chat, messaging, or note-taking features.
You want to connect text inputs to the LanguageTool API with minimal boilerplate.
avoid_when: You need offline-only spell-checking without calling an external API.
You want a standard platform-default spell checker rather than LanguageTool integration.
strengths: Real-time spell-checking and error highlighting as users type.
Supports custom debounce and throttle delays for API requests.
Extends Flutter's native TextField and matches its API.
weaknesses: Requires an external LanguageTool API connection.
Depends on network availability for checks.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the package dependency and instantiate LanguageToolController and LanguageToolTextField.
